description: This file defines a MockLogger class for testing purposes, extending the Logger class and utilizing Monolog's TestHandler. It is part of the OrangeHRM testing utilities, providing a mock logger setup for unit tests.

classes.name: MockLogger
classes.description: A mock logger class used for testing, extending the main Logger class and providing access to a TestHandler instance.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the MockLogger by calling the parent constructor with a test channel name and a TestHandler instance.

methods.name: getTestHandler
methods.description: Returns the first handler, which is a TestHandler, used in testing scenarios.
